# Apex Works

Apex Works is based in Monroe, Washington. We do website audits for Washington businesses. We also help with Google search and with AI optimization, so tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend a business.

We work with local businesses and service-area businesses across Washington. A business can get help even if it works from home and does not publish a street address.

Contact: damon@theapexworks.com
Website: https://theapexworks.com

## Apex Site Snapshot

The Apex Site Snapshot is a one-time $499 website audit for Washington local businesses. The Snapshot itself is not a monthly plan. Checkout is at https://buy.stripe.com/cNieVf0KFcYJffUfBQcMM00 and the page is https://theapexworks.com/snapshot.

What we check:
1. AI crawlers can reach you. Your text shows without JavaScript.
2. Your business facts match across Google, Bing, Apple, Yelp, Facebook, BBB and Angi.
3. Call-tracking numbers aren't hiding your real number.
4. Trust signals like license, insurance and years in business.
5. Service pages, pricing and FAQs.
6. Reviews.
7. Speed and mobile.

What you get:
- A plain-English score
- A prioritized fix list
- An AI-recommendation check
- A 20-minute Zoom walkthrough
- The report within about 48 hours
- $499 one time

After the audit:
1. Fix it yourself or have your web person do it using our instructions.
2. We make the fixes (one-time). No price is listed for that job.
3. The monthly Site Care Plan: hosting, upkeep, AI optimization, and a monthly report including AI prompt testing. https://theapexworks.com/site-care

We promise the process and the reporting, not rankings. Google and AI tools change too often for anyone to guarantee those.

You don't need to publish your home address, because we set you up as a service-area business.

## How it works

1. Buy the Snapshot. You pay $499 once.
2. We write the report. It arrives within about 48 hours after payment.
3. We walk you through it on a 20-minute Zoom.
4. You fix it yourself, we make the fixes once, or you use the monthly Site Care Plan.

## FAQ

What's in the Snapshot?
You get a plain-English score, a prioritized fix list, an AI-recommendation check, a 20-minute Zoom walkthrough, and the report within about 48 hours. The price is $499 one time.

How long does it take?
The report arrives within about 48 hours after payment.

Do I need a web person?
No. You can fix it yourself or have your web person do it using our instructions. We can also make the fixes as a one-time job.

I work from home. Do I have to publish my home address?
No. You don't need to publish your home address, because we set you up as a service-area business.

Do you guarantee rankings or a refund?
We promise the process and the reporting, not rankings. Google and AI tools change too often for anyone to guarantee those. For refund questions, email damon@theapexworks.com.

What happens after I pay?
You'll get an email to schedule the 20-minute Zoom walkthrough.

## Site Care Plan

Page: https://theapexworks.com/site-care

The monthly Site Care Plan is hosting, upkeep, AI optimization, and a monthly report that includes AI prompt testing. It is for local and service-area businesses in Washington. Apex Works is based in Monroe, WA.

Hosting means the website sits on a server so people can open it. Upkeep means Apex Works keeps looking after the site after it is online. The monthly report includes AI prompt testing. AI optimization does not guarantee that ChatGPT, Google, or any other tool will recommend a business.

No price and no turnaround time are published for this service. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing.

## AI optimization

Page: https://theapexworks.com/ai-optimization

AI optimization is help getting a business named when people ask ChatGPT, Google's AI answers, and similar tools for a recommendation. The work is on the website and Google presence so those tools have a fair chance to find the business.

Apex Works does not guarantee that ChatGPT, Google, or any other tool will recommend a business. No price and no turnaround time are published for this service. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing.

The $499 Site Snapshot includes a check on whether those tools can recommend you. AI optimization is a separate service.
